exposure: Use of biologic therapy at conception
Use of conventional medications or no treatment at conception
cohort: The study included 298 women with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) who had quiescent disease at the time of conception and were recruited from a multidisciplinary clinic.
finding: Prior IBD-related surgery and biologic therapy at conception were identified as independent protective factors against IBD relapse during pregnancy in women with quiescent disease.
followup_time: Up to birth (outcomes measured during pregnancy and at delivery)
birth_weight: Median birthweights were 2987 grams for babies born to mothers with IBD flare and 3153 grams for those born to mothers who maintained remission.
